name: amberart-run
description: Run one of AmberArt's declared operations. Destructive rows are marked in the description — confirm with the user before running one.

command.description: amberart.undo — Undo; amberart.redo — Redo; amberart.export — Export as PNG; amberart.layer.clear — Clear the active layer (destructive); amberart.layer.add — Add a layer; amberart.layer.toggle — Show / hide this layer; amberart.layer.raise — Bring forward; amberart.layer.lower — Send back; amberart.layer.clear — Clear this layer (destructive); amberart.layer.remove — Delete this layer (destructive); amberart.layer.add — Add a layer; amberart.export — Export as PNG

data.description: Context the row would have carried — the item, list or selection the command acts on.
